notes.title: Update 1.0i
notes.notes:
[h3]⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Greataxe skill is now doing damage based on unused capacity on given die => +1 damage per unused capacity.
[*] Decay skill is now inflicting Weak and Vulnerable based on unused capacity on given die => +1 Weak and +1 Vulnerable per 3 unused capacity.
[/list]

[h3]✨ IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Modifiers selection is now persistent between runs.
[*] Descriptions of Feather, Thunderstorm and Chain Lightning updated to more reflect skills and relic effects.
[*] Whetstone description updated to reflect, that Whetstone does not work with ultimate skill.
[*] Jumping via Portal now shows quick teleport loading screen.
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unstable Energy in upgraded version is fixed.
[*] Issue with possible Bratwurst abuse when visiting Merchant is fixed.
[*] Multiple bugs in all translations are fixed.
[*] Dialogues in Russian language are fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0j
notes.notes:
[h3]✨ IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Borderless fullscreen is now default setting, you can now move freely mouse cursor outside of the game screen.
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Order of floating text when enemy dies is fixed.
[*] Corrupted files are now fixed automatically on game start.*
[*] Russian translation adjusted.
[/list]
* If you already have corrupted files the fixing process may erase your progress.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0h
notes.notes:
[h3]✨ IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] New indicator for Dungeon cleared is displayed on the map.
[*] Skills, Relics and Enemies in Compendium are sorted in alphabetical order.
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Highscore issue with unsorted entry at the end of the list is fixed.
[*] Record in compendium after killing Mimic is correctly updated. 
[*] Upgrading Curse(s) via Relics is no longer possible. 
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0g
notes.notes: [h3]✨ IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][list][*][p]Multiplier can be viewed in hero selection by hovering over Maelor's Vial.  [/p][/*][*][p]Save notification is displayed every time game is saved.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3][list][*][p] Typos and incorrect translations fixed in Polish.  [/p][/*][*][p]Typos and incorrect translations fixed in Czech. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0e & 1.0f
notes.notes:
[h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Blood Link description is updated and no longer indicates "Heal" type.
[*] On-roll skills are now correctly return to the initial position.
[*] Rewind turn is no longer restarting use count on skills.
[*] Fixed issue with saving after buying out all items in Merchant event.
[*] Notification is no longer blocking skill from being dropped. 
[*] History is now correctly showing traits.
[*] Fixed a bug where modifiers were being shared between heroes with locked and unlocked Modifiers.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0c & 1.0d
notes.notes:
[h3]🛠️ FIXES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Screen resolution: issue with generating enemies out of dungeon for different screen resolutions is fixed.
[*] Compendium is now correctly synced with a Steam account.
[*] Grinding Wheel event now has correct description.
[*] Visual fix for tutorial in main menu.
[*] Issue with unlocked characters is resolved and now all unlocked characters should be available in character selection.
[/list]

notes.title: Publisher Reveal + New Release Date: Launching August 1st
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h1]🎉 We’ve Partnered with a Publisher![/h1][p]
Hey everyone, we’ve got exciting news.[/p][p][i]Luck & Loot[/i] is officially teaming up with [b]GrabTheGames[/b] as our publishing partner.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=GrabTheGames"][b]GrabTheGames[/b][/url] has been [b]supporting indie titles[/b] on Steam [b]for over a decade.[/b] Their experience with [b]visibility, launch strategy, and influencer outreach will be a huge boost[/b] as we prepare for release. 

You can [b]check out their work at [url="https://grabthegames.com"]grabthegames.com[/url][/b]. We’ve been handling [i]Luck & Loot[/i] as a scrappy, independent team, and this partnership allows us to [b]keep our creative vision intact while giving the game a real shot at reaching a wider audience[/b].
[/p][h2]🗓 New Release Date: [b]August 1[/b][/h2][p]To make the most of this opportunity, [b]we’re shifting our release date slightly to[/b] [b]August 1[/b]. This lines us up with GrabTheGames’ upcoming [b]publisher sale and a larger promotional push[/b]. It gives us more visibility and delivers a stronger, [b]more polished launch for everyone[/b].[/p][p]We know some of you were looking forward to the July 22 release. [b]Thank you so much for your support[/b]. The extra time will go toward [b]fine-tuning and getting ready to roll out localization support post-launch[/b], starting in mid-August.
[/p][h2]💬 What This Means[/h2][p][b]Nothing changes about the heart of the game[/b]. [i]Luck & Loot[/i] is still the same weird, tactical, dice-slinging roguelike you’ve been following. But now [b]we have marketing support, more community reach, and a real shot at making a bigger splash[/b].[/p][p][b]You’ll still hear directly from us[/b] as development continues. We’re handling all design, story, sound, and updates as always. [b]We’re just better equipped now[/b].
[/p][h2]🎲 Wishlist, Share, and Join the Community[/h2][p][b]The best way to support us right now is by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3208110/Luck__Loot/"]wishlisting on Steam[/url] and sharing the game with friends[/b] who love dice-builders, eldritch fantasy, or getting completely wrecked by RNG.[/p][p]Want to hang out, chat with the devs, and meet other players?
[b]Come join our growing Discord community:[/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/xDMpTMXnqd"]https://discord.gg/xDMpTMXnqd[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thanks again for being part of this with us.[/b] 
We’re pumped for August 1 and can’t wait to show you what’s coming next.[/p][p]— The SMARTcreative team[/p]
